metadata.title: DEEIX Chat · Multi-model AI workspace
metadata.description: Compare models, manage knowledge, and use a focused AI workspace across desktop and mobile.

hero.title: Chat, compare, and build with the right model.
hero.description: DEEIX Chat brings model selection, project materials, sharing, billing, and mobile-first chat into one focused workspace.

preview.title: Example workspace
preview.question: Which model should handle a document-heavy task?
preview.answer: Start with a reasoning model, keep project materials attached, then compare with a faster option before sharing.
preview.note: Model, materials, and sharing controls stay in the same chat flow.

features.title: Built around real chat work
features.description: Core tools stay close to the conversation, so you can move from idea to reusable result without switching products.
